author: Kushal_mgr
title: Complaint Regarding Poor Customer Support and Unresolved Issue
review_text: Dear eSewa Support Team,  I am very disappointed with your customer support. I chose eSewa while living in Kuwait because I believed it would be a reliable and convenient service. However, my experience has been frustrating, and my valuable time has been wasted.  I reported my “Validation Failed” issue, but even after 3–4 days, I have not received any response or solution. I can transfer money to other eSewa accounts, but I cannot transfer money to my own account.  This lack of response and support is unacceptable. I expected better service from a trusted digital wallet provider.  Please take my complaint seriously, investigate the issue, and provide a proper response and solution as soon as possible.
